title: Offspring Data
description: Defines how offspring inherit traits from parent entities.

blend_attributes.description: If true, the entities will blend their attributes in the offspring after they breed. For example, horses blend their health, movement, and jump_strength in their offspring.

breeds_with.description: The entity definitions that this entity can breed with. Can be a single object or an array.

combine_parent_colors.description: If true, the offspring's color will be a combination of both parents' colors.

deny_parents_variant.description: Determines how likely the baby of parents with the same variant will deny that variant and take a random variant within the given range instead.

inherit_tamed.description: If true, the babies will be automatically tamed if its parents are.

mutation_factor.description: Determines how likely the babies are to NOT inherit one of their parent's variances.

mutation_strategy.description: Strategy used for mutating inherited traits.

parent_centric_attribute_blending.description: List of attributes that should benefit from parent centric attribute blending. For example, horses blend their health, movement, and jump_strength in their offspring.

property_inheritance.description: List of Entity Properties that should be inherited from the parent entities and potentially mutated.

random_variant_mutation_interval.description: Range used to determine random variant.

baby_type.description: The entity definition of this entity's babies.

breed_event.description: Event to run when this entity breeds. Can be a simple event name string or a trigger object with event and optional filters.

mate_type.description: The entity definition that this entity can mate with.

chance.description: The percentage chance of denying the parents' variant.

max_variant.description: The inclusive maximum of the variant range.

min_variant.description: The inclusive minimum of the variant range.

color.description: The percentage chance of denying the parents' variant.

extra_variant.description: The percentage chance of a mutation on the entity's extra variant type.

variant.description: The percentage chance of a mutation on the entity's variant type.
